title: Webhook provider: referenced Secrets must carry the label `external-secrets.io/type: webhook`

detection.reason: the labels of the Secrets a webhook store references are not joined to the store; the store projection carries key names only

quote: Webhook provider now can only use secrets that are labeled with `external-secrets.io/type: webhook`. This enforces explicit setup for webhook secrets by users.
remediation: Before upgrading, add the label `external-secrets.io/type: webhook` to every Secret referenced from `spec.provider.webhook.secrets[].secretRef` of the stores named; an unlabeled Secret makes every ExternalSecret on that store fail to sync.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("webhook")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) secrets=\([.spec.provider.webhook.secrets[]?.secretRef.name] | join(","))"'  # each row is a webhook store and the Secrets it reads; check their labels
coversNotes: v0.10.0 (What's Changed): feat: webhook secrets must be labeled

title: Webhook generator: Secret label renamed `generators.external-secrets.io/type` → `external-secrets.io/type`

detection.reason: Webhook generator objects are not collected; the ExternalSecrets that reference one are

quote: Webhook generator labels have changed from `generators.external-secrets.io/type: webhook` to `external-secrets.io/type: webhook`.
remediation: Relabel every Secret a Webhook generator reads: replace `generators.external-secrets.io/type: webhook` with `external-secrets.io/type: webhook`. The ExternalSecrets named use a Webhook generator and stop refreshing otherwise.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secrets -A -l generators.external-secrets.io/type=webhook -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["external-secrets.io/type"] != "webhook") | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a Secret still carrying only the old label

title: ClusterExternalSecret `namespaceSelector` is deprecated in favour of `namespaceSelectors`
quote: The field `namespaceSelector` has been deprecated in favor of `namespaceSelectors` and will be removed in a future
remediation: Move `spec.namespaceSelector` to a one-element `spec.namespaceSelectors` list on each ClusterExternalSecret named. The singular field still works in 2.14.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.namespaceSelector != null) | .metadata.name'  # each name still sets the deprecated singular selector
coversNotes: v0.10.0 (What's Changed): Update docs for namespaceSelectors usage and namespaceSelector depreca

title: Pulumi ESC provider: `project` is now required (upstream calls it `projectID`)

detection.reason: a missing key is not a projected value; the store projection names the keys present

quote: **WARNING**: With this update, Pulumi has added `projectID` to it's required properties.
remediation: Add `spec.provider.pulumi.project` (the CRD field upstream's note calls `projectID`) to each Pulumi store named before upgrading; the CRD rejects any later update of a store without it. The same release moves the CRD's `apiUrl` default from `https://api.pulumi.com/api/preview` to `https://api.pulumi.com/api/esc`; a store created earlier keeps the old default persisted, so set `apiUrl: https://api.pulumi.com/api/esc` on it as well.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("pulumi")) | select((.spec.provider.pulumi.project // "") == "" or (.spec.provider.pulumi.apiUrl // "" | test("/api/preview"))) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) project=\(.spec.provider.pulumi.project // "-") apiUrl=\(.spec.provider.pulumi.apiUrl // "-")"'  # each row is a Pulumi store missing project or still on the /api/preview URL

title: Helm chart: default image registry moved from ghcr.io to oci.external-secrets.io

detection.reason: Helm values and registry allow-lists are not collected; the running image is

quote: From this version onwards, the default image registry name will be oci.external-secrets.io.
remediation: If image pulls are restricted (egress firewall, admission allow-list, pull-through mirror), allow `oci.external-secrets.io` or pin `image.repository`, `webhook.image.repository` and `certController.image.repository` before upgrading; the chart changed the default for all three. The default moves back to ghcr.io in 1.1 (rtz-external-secrets-1.1-default-image-registry-ghcr).
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)(external-secrets/external-secrets|bitnami/external-secrets)([:@]|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | join(","))"'  # each row is an ESO workload and the registry it pulls from today
coversNotes: v0.10.4 (What's Changed): chore: updates default oci
chart value certController.image.repository default changed ghcr.io/external-secrets -> oci.external-secrets.io/
chart value image.repository default changed ghcr.io/external-secrets -> oci.external-secrets.io/
chart value webhook.image.repository default changed ghcr.io/external-secrets -> oci.external-secrets.io/
